verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say checks received in the mailbox are deposited without you going to the bank. Deposits are priced per deposit, and multiple checks can be batched together, so the provider handles the paper end to end. Missing for 10: any description of endorsement handling, any reconciliation or deposit-status reporting back to the user, supported banks and timelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond brief marketing lines.
